name: tungsten
enchant_note: So dense and dead that magic cannot get into it.
protection_note: The densest metal there is: a hammer barely dents it.
protection_price: It is half again as heavy as steel, and it conducts lightning.
lore_descriptor: gray and so heavy that it drags at the limb that bears it
first_pickup_chronicle: Tungsten armor, very dense. Spells slide off. Can barely stand in it.
design_notes: Fills pf 48 gap. Heavy-family bonus (damage_mult 1.4, weight 1.6×). Magic-resistant (max_enchant 1) — warrior favorite, anti-mage.
